title: INCHAINPEPEGAN
author: lifeonchain
facts: offchain — GAN trained on pepes, generator ported to Solidity
three 5×5 frames, assembled onchain into an animated GIF
description: A GAN generator that draws animated pepes inside tokenURI. Each call derives three latent seeds from the token id, runs each through a dense layer and two transposed-convolution stages in int16 fixed-point arithmetic (1 sign, 3 mantissa, 12 fraction bits) with a 256-entry logistic lookup table, and encodes the three 5×5 RGB frames as an animated GIF — all in Solidity. The weights were trained offchain, then written into the contract's storage arrays in the deployment transactions; weights, forward pass, and GIF encoder all live at one address and the image exists nowhere else.

call.note: tokenURI(1) — runs the generator three times (one per frame) and assembles the animated GIF onchain
